offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Check the connection, then try again.

error.not_approved: Paper is waiting for you to allow it in Settings → Plugins on this chat's device.
error.offline: Can't reach this chat's device right now.
error.not_installed: Paper isn't on this chat's device. Install it in Settings → Plugins there.
error.off: Paper is off on this chat's device. Turn it on in Settings → Plugins there.
error.version_mismatch: This chat's device has another version of Paper. Update it in Settings → Plugins.
error.timeout: This chat's device took too long to answer.
error.failed: Something went wrong on this chat's device.

no_agents: No Claude Code, Codex or Pi found on this device.
